mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_video_series ( series_name, series_description, user_id, sort, update_time ) VALUES ( #{seriesName}, #{seriesDescription}, #{userId}, #{sort}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_video_series WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sort ASC, series_id DESC

SELECT t.*,v.video_cover cover FROM ( SELECT *,(SELECT video_id FROM user_video_series_video v WHERE v.series_id=s.series_id ORDER BY sort asc LIMIT 1) video_id FROM user_video_series s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}) t LEFT JOIN video_info v ON t.video_id=v.video_id ORDER BY t.sort asc;

series_name = #{seriesName},
series_description = #{seriesDescription},
sort = #{sort},
